title: IssueLighter: An Issue Type-Aware LLM Agent for Issue Report Validity Assessment
title_zh: IssueLighter：面向问题报告有效性评估的问题类型感知LLM智能体

paragraphs.en: IssueLighter是问题类型感知的LLM智能体框架，评估OSS问题报告有效性且F1提升超20个百分点。 Invalid issue reports are prevalent in open source software (OSS) projects, imposing substantial burdens on maintainers who already face a high risk of burnout. Prior research has primarily focused on identifying invalid reports for specific issue categories (e.g., bug and wontfix), leaving the broader landscape of OSS issue types largely unexplored and limiting the generalizability of existing approaches. Moreover, existing methods provide little support for explaining or validating their predictions, reducing their practical usefulness for maintainers. With the rise of LLM-based agents, it remains unclear whether a comprehensive understanding of the causes of invalidity across all issue types can improve validity assessment performance while producing well-grounded rationales. To this end, we first manually annotated the validity status of 520 issue reports from three OSS projects, i.e., pandas, scikit-learn, and mypy, resulting in 257 invalid reports and 263 valid ones. Then, we conducted a thematic analysis on these invalid reports and identified 13 causes of invalidity that are closely specific to issue types. Based on these insights, we propose IssueLighter, an agent-based framework with a type-aware validity assessment strategy that dynamically executes commands. Experimental results show that IssueLighter consistently and substantially outperforms all baseline methods, with an average F1 improvement of over 20 percentage points. Ablation studies confirm that both the type-aware strategy and the taxonomy of causes of invalidity contribute to the performance gains. Qualitative analysis further demonstrates that IssueLighter generates rationales grounded in accurately identified causes of invalidity and supported by evidence. Moreover, leveraging these rationales, we challenged maintainers' original decisions in four disputed cases, and all received approval.
paragraphs.zh: IssueLighter是问题类型感知的LLM智能体框架，用于评估OSS问题报告有效性，F1提升超过20个百分点。无效的问题报告在开源软件（OSS）项目中普遍存在，给本已面临较高倦怠风险的项目维护者带来了沉重负担。 已有研究主要集中在识别特定问题类别（如bug和wontfix）中的无效报告，而对OSS问题类型的更广泛图景在很大程度上尚未被探索，这限制了现有方法的泛化能力。 此外，现有方法在解释或验证其预测方面提供的支持很少，降低了其对维护者的实际实用性。 随着基于LLM的智能体的兴起，对所有问题类型的无效成因形成全面理解是否能够提升有效性评估性能，同时产生有充分依据的理由，仍然不得而知。 为此，我们首先人工标注了来自三个OSS项目（即pandas、scikit-learn和mypy）的520份问题报告的有效性状态，得到257份无效报告和263份有效报告。 然后，我们对这些无效报告进行了主题分析，识别出13种与问题类型密切相关的无效成因。 基于这些洞察，我们提出了IssueLighter，这是一个基于智能体的框架，采用类型感知的有效性评估策略，能够动态执行命令。 实验结果表明，IssueLighter持续且大幅地优于所有基线方法，平均F1提升超过20个百分点。 消融研究证实，类型感知策略和无效成因分类体系都对性能提升有所贡献。 定性分析进一步表明，IssueLighter生成的理由基于准确识别的无效成因，并有证据支持。 此外，利用这些理由，我们在四个存在争议的案例中对维护者的原始决定提出了质疑，且全部获得了认可。
